theorem_title: Bound for the height from places above 2 on the tripod
formal_statement:
theorem AbcAdaptation.Tripod.twoAdicBound (P : CurveProviders) (K : CompactlyBounded) :
    TwoAdicBoundHyp P K (max (4 * K.c) 0) := by sorry
natural_language_statement:
Let $K$ be a compactly bounded subset of the tripod with logarithmic bound $c$. The bounds on $\lambda$ and $\lambda-1$ apply at the finite places of $\mathbb Q(\lambda)$ above $2$. Let $P$ be a tripod curve provider. For each point $x$ in $K$, write $F_x$ for the field of its supplied curve. At a place $w$ of multiplicative reduction above $2$, let $m_w$ be the order of the Tate parameter and let $f_w$ be the residue degree over $2$.

Prove that for every $x$ in $K$,

$$\frac{1}{[F_x:\mathbb Q]}\sum_{\substack{w\mid 2\\w\ \text{of multiplicative reduction}}} m_w f_w\log 2\ \le\ \max(4c,0).$$
